sources.title: MobileViTV2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MobileViTV2 is the second version of MobileViT, constructed by replacing the multi-headed self-attention in MobileViT with separable self-attention. The abstract from the paper is the following: Mobile vision transformers (MobileViT) can achieve state-of-the-art performance across several mobile vision tasks, including classification and detection.

sources.title: transformers/docs/source/en/model_doc/mobilevit.md at main ...
sources.snippet: MobileViT is a lightweight vision transformer for mobile devices that merges CNN's efficiency and inductive biases with transformers global context modeling. It treats transformers as convolutions, enabling global information processing without the heavy computational cost of standard ViTs.

sources.title: GitHub - yangyucheng000/MobileViT
sources.snippet: MobileViT is a lightweight, general purpose transformer vision. MobileViT proposes a different perspective, using transformers as convolutions to process information. The results show that MobileViT significantly outperforms CNN and ViT based networks on different tasks and datasets.

sources.title: [2110.02178] MobileViT: Light-weight, General-purpose, and Mobile ...
sources.snippet: Towards this end, we introduce MobileViT, a light-weight and general-purpose vision transformer for mobile devices. MobileViT presents a different perspective for the global processing of information with transformers, i.e., transformers as convolutions.
